title: Nauheimer Straße, Stuttgart
description:
The city is not only home to prestigious universities, but is also surrounded by lush vineyards and nature, making it an attractive option for those who like to spend time outside. The famous Wilhelma Zoo and the banks of the River Neckar are both just a stone's throw away. 

Students will find a furnished and flexible temporary home in our flats, close to the popular Bad Cannstatter Wasen festival grounds. You’ll have easy access to vibrant cultural attractions, and both the Mercedes-Benz head(hidden) and the training grounds of VfL Stuttgart football club are closeby. 

You’ll have access not only to your flat, but also to community spaces, including a gaming room and a laundry lounge. Our flats are ideal for students or as an urban base for commuters.

We stand for modern fully-furnished apartments, free use of various community spaces, House Manager services, and various events and activities for a monthly all-in rental.

Inclusive furniture rent
Inclusive utilities
Inclusive internet
Inclusive common spaces
Inclusive House Manager Service

Single bed

Flat-screen TV

title: Andreästraße, Stuttgart
description:
✨Light-flooded room is looking for new residents✨

A furnished room will be available in our beautiful shared apartment and now we might be looking for you :)

Here again the Hard Facts about the house:
- furnished room *without a mattress 
- fitted kitchen with a dining area 
- bathroom 
- separate toilet
- washing machine
- dishwasher 

The additional costs include the following items.
- heating
- water
- sewage
- garbage
- caretaker service

Additional costs which are not included:
- electricity
- internet 
- the  using of the kitchen will be charged with a one-time payment of 200,00 €.

We look forward to your application and would be happy to invite you to take a look around.

Location:
The shared flat is located right next to the S-Bahn and U-Bahn station Nürnberger Straße (1 min walk), but you can hardly hear the train at all. The street is in a cul-de-sac, which is why street noise is not a problem or hardly present. There are plenty of parking spaces on the side of the street.

A Penny is within walking distance (approx. 7 min). A bakery, doner kebab and many other shopping facilities can also be found in the Bad Canstatt city centre (Lidl, Kaufland, Müller, dm, etc.) and are only a few minutes away by underground/train. Within 7 minutes you can reach Stuttgart main station with the S2 or S3, which run every 5-10 minutes at peak times. The upper Kurpark with its marvellous views is just a few minutes' walk away.

Shared flat life:
We are looking for a flatmate for our vacant room.

Cleanliness and tidiness are important to us and of course there is a cleaning schedule in the shared flat.

We would be happy if you could write a few lines about yourself in your message. This will help us to better assess whether you would fit into our flat-sharing community :)

Just write to us - we look forward to it.

Please be aware that HousingAnywhere is an online booking platform. Therefore, exchanging contact details and offering viewings is not possible. If you would like to reserve this accommodation, send me a booking request or a message, and please mention your age and occupation. I look forward to meeting you!

Bad Cannstatt is Stuttgart’s most populous and oldest district. The apartment is centrally located in Bad Cannstatt, in a multi-family house. The house and owners’ community is middle-aged and closely connected, for example through regular community activities.

Bad Cannstatt ist der einwohnerstärkste und älteste Stadtbezirk Stuttgarts. Die Wohnung liegt sehr zentral in Bad Cannstatt, in einem Mehrfamilienhaus. Die Haus- und Eigentümergemeinschaft ist mittleren Alters und seit Jahren sehr eng, z.B. über gemeinsame hausinterne Aktivitäten, verbunden.

Die Wohnung ist mit Fernbahn, S-Bahn, U-Bahn und Schnellbusverbindung optimal an den SSB und DB Nah- und Fernverkehr angebunden. Die Innenstadt/Uni liegt in 10 minütiger SSB und S-Bahn Nähe (5 Minuten Fußweg). Die Richtungen Universität Vaihingen, Böblingen/Sindelfingen, Zuffenhausen und Waiblingen werden durch die S-Bahn Haltestelle Bad-Cannstatt (7 Minuten Fußweg) abgedeckt.

Stadtmobile, als großer Car Sharing Anbieter in Stuttgart, verfügt in Bad Cannstatt über die größte Fahrzeugdichte aller Fahrzeugklassen.

In unmittelbarer Umgebung bieten das 350 m entfernte Cannstatter Carré als Einkaufsmall sowie Discounter, kleine Gemüsehändler und Metzger fußläufig erreichbare Einkaufsmöglichkeiten aller Art.

Der Kurpark liegt wenige Schritte entfernt, verfügt über den größten Biergarten Stuttgarts und bietet beste Erholungsmöglichkeiten.

Drei Mineralbäder Stuttgarts können zu Fuß oder mit den Öffentlichen Verkehrsmitteln in max. 5 bis 10 Minuten erreicht werden.

Das Cannstatter Krankenhaus ist binnen 4 Minuten mit dem PKW oder Taxi zu erreichen
